answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation staking tied to verified work history: an agent must lock a deposit and build a record of completed, peer-attested tasks before its votes count. New identities start like seeds in a garden, cheap to plant, but they earn no weight until they prove themselves. Attackers cannot forge that history at scale, because each fake identity must fund its own stake and survive in the tundra of public scrutiny, where clones with no track record are ignored and slashed deposits make mass forgery unprofitable.
